theorems.name: Submission.intcpt_allard_bsb_marginal_measure
theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (m : Measure (Euclidean N × Grassmannian N n)) (g : Euclidean N × Grassmannian N n → ℝ≥0∞), ∃ τ : Measure (Euclidean N), ∀ A : Set (Euclidean N), MeasurableSet A → τ A = ∫⁻ z in A ×ˢ (univ : Set (Grassmannian N n)), g z ∂m
